decision.explanation: Document D1 explicitly states Guy Middleton was a citizen of the 'United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland' based on his birth in London in 1907. Document D2 explicitly states he held 'dual citizenship' with the 'Kingdom of Italy' (referred to as 'Italy' in the answer slot) and that his Italian citizenship was officially recognized in 1935. Both sources positively assign distinct citizenships to the same individual, satisfying the requirement to preserve complementary answers and not collapse multi-answer questions.
